answer: The sparrow counter is kept in jetty and thread shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 67 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
